summary: A broad, active, MIT and provenance-signed headless set backed by Zag.js state machines. The dialog spike passed with role=dialog, aria-modal=true and focus inside at 258.60 KB / 81.97 KB gzip. It is held because the package pins 69 @zag-js dependencies and installs about 44 MB, and its community is smaller than React Aria or Radix.
reasoning: Active release line: 5.40.0 published 2026-10-29; repository pushed 2026-11-03; 5.4k stars and 5 open issues.
Peers React >=18, so React 18 and 19 are covered.
MIT with a permissive tree; no required CSS runtime.
npm provenance is present via GitHub Actions trusted publishing.
No install scripts and no recorded OSV advisories.
The React 19 dialog spike opened with role=dialog, aria-modal=true and focus inside.
The bundle was 258.60 KB / 81.97 KB gzip; about 44 MB installed with React 19.
The dependency graph is large: 69 pinned @zag-js packages. It is tree-shakeable, but the install and upgrade surface are bigger than Base UI or Ariakit.
caveats: Smaller community than React Aria or Radix.
No local spike for complex widgets beyond the dialog.
Broad component coverage, but the dependency graph and version coupling are the trade-off.

evidence.label: License
evidence.detail: MIT; the isolated tree is MIT, Apache-2.0 and 0BSD only.

evidence.label: React compatibility
evidence.detail: peerDependencies react/react-dom: >=18.0.0. The spike used React 19.2.0.

evidence.label: Dependency footprint
evidence.detail: 69 runtime dependencies, all pinned @zag-js packages; about 44 MB installed with React 19; 3.3 MB unpacked.

evidence.label: Install scripts
evidence.detail: No preinstall, install or postinstall script in the isolated tree.

evidence.label: TypeScript types
evidence.detail: Bundled declarations through the package exports.

evidence.label: npm provenance
evidence.detail: SLSA provenance is present on 5.40.0; npm records GitHub Actions as the publisher via a trusted publisher.

evidence.label: React browser spike
evidence.detail: A Vite production build rendered an open dialog in Chrome 1200x800 with role=dialog, aria-modal=true and focus inside. The JS bundle was 258.60 KB / 81.97 KB gzip including React 19.

evidence.label: Component coverage
evidence.detail: Broad headless coverage across overlays, menus, selection, date/time and form widgets, implemented through Zag.js state machines.
